research_result.description: Devin is an AI software engineering platform offering REST APIs and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing sessions, playbooks, knowledge, schedules, and repository interactions.
research_result.credential_requirements: Users can generate service user API keys or personal access tokens (prefixed with cog_) within account settings on app.devin.ai under Settings > Service users or the PATs tab.

evidence.claim: Devin provides REST APIs for programmatic interaction.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Learn how to programmatically interact with Devin using our REST APIs

evidence.claim: Devin uses API keys passed as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request:

evidence.claim: Devin provides a self-serve Free plan for getting started.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Free plan lets you try Devin with limited usage.

evidence.claim: Devin has an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server available.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Devin MCP server provides programmatic access to Devin's platform capabilities for both private and public repositories.
